messages.subject: Re: convert Shiny output to html/Javascript

Sharon,
You will need some kind of server to handle the starting up and shutting down of R processes.  The HTML/Javascript/CSS produced is only part of what you need to share Shiny apps.  Or are you building your own server to start up R processes?
